build_BaseTransformer: build a multimodal transformer model by extending BaseTransformer and implementing the required abstract methods
build_BaseTransformerBackend: build a transformer backend by extending BaseTransformerBackend and implementing build_transformer_config and build_embeddings
build_BaseTransformerHead: build a transformer head by extending BaseTransformerHead and implementing the forward method
review_BaseTransformer_build: review the BaseTransformer build method which constructs backend, encoders, heads, losses and initializes weights
review_BaseTransformer_get_optimizer_par: review the get_optimizer_parameters method to understand how learning rate groups are configured for heads and encoders
